title: Set It Up
score_note: the lead chemistry is the engine; the bosses' romance is the plot

beats.name: TWO ASSISTANTS
cap: two assistants in one tower collide over
a dinner order neither of them can pay for
beats.tag: MEET-CUTE — a lobby, a dinner order, no cash

beats.name: THE PITCH
cap: she proposes setting their bosses up so
the two of them might get their lives back
beats.tag: THE SCHEME — a plan to buy back their own time

beats.name: THE ELEVATOR
cap: they stall the elevator to force a meeting;
a panicking delivery man ruins the plan
beats.tag: THE SCHEME FAILS — the meet-cute goes wrong

beats.name: THE KISS-CAM
cap: a bribed kiss-cam finally gets the bosses
kissing, and the assistants breathe again
beats.tag: THE SCHEME WORKS — the bosses are dating

beats.name: THE MAINTENANCE
cap: the bosses wobble, so the assistants write
notes, gifts, and a rented weekend away
beats.tag: THE MAINTENANCE — the romance becomes a project

beats.name: THE ENGAGEMENT PARTY
cap: Suze blows him off, so Charlie goes with
Harper to her best friend's engagement party
beats.tag: THE PAIRING — the assistants arrive as a couple

beats.name: THE ENGAGEMENT
cap: the bosses come home engaged; Rick wanted
a ring only to aggravate his ex-wife Kiki
beats.tag: THE ROT — the ring is a weapon, not a promise

beats.name: THE RUPTURE
cap: she overhears Rick on the phone with Kiki
and finds out that Charlie knew all along
beats.tag: THE RUPTURE — the scheme outgrows the friendship

beats.name: THE TRUTH
cap: she tells Kirsten the whole plan and is
fired for it; the wedding is still on
beats.tag: THE CONFESSION — the truth costs her the job

beats.name: THE CUT
cap: he breaks up with Suze and quits the job
he never wanted, then races to the airport
beats.tag: THE CUT — the job and the girlfriend go

beats.name: THE AIRPORT
cap: he tells Kirsten that Rick will never know
her; at the gate she leaves him behind
beats.tag: THE UNRAVELING — the scheme dies at the gate

beats.name: THE SETUP
cap: Kirsten plays matchmaker in the office and
they confess it, despite every reason not to
beats.tag: THE SETUP — the boss engineers the real thing
